items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Duke Ellington's band. This was a great band... band was Louie Bellson, Wendell Marshall, I believe, Shorty Baker, Cooke, what's his name. [INTERVIEWER] Willie. [INTERVIEWEE] Willie Cooke, Willie Smith...

ctx.x: I'm sure I will enjoy that. But coming back to travelling now, I'm going to go back with the Big Show now. This is the big Show of '51. We travelled with -- it was Nat Cole, Duke Ellington, and quite a few acts, but I'm not interested in acts now. Duke Ellington's band. This was a great band, this particular band was a great band. And this was -- band was Louie Bellson, Wendell Marshall, I believe, Shorty Baker, Cooke, what's his name.
Willie Cooke, Willie Smith, Procope and of course Carnaby, and Paul Gonzales. Now, I have a -- I felt very close to Paul because Paul is a good guitarist. I don't know whether you realize it.
